```yaml
name: Clang Static Analyzer

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - stable

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  clang-analyzer:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/devcontainers/cpp:1-ubuntu
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install LLVM and Clang
        uses: KyleMayes/install-llvm-action@v2
        with:
          version: "16"
          directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/llvm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          apt-get update
          apt-get install -y \
            build-essential \
            cmake \
            pkg-config \
            libssl-dev \
            libgnutls28-dev \
            liblmdb-dev \
            libjansson-dev \
            libcurl4-openssl-dev \
            libpcre2-dev \
            libsystemd-dev \
            liblogging-stdlog-dev \
            liblz4-dev \
            libzstd-dev \
            libsnappy-dev \
            libxml2-dev \
            libgcrypt20-dev \
            libgpgme-dev \
            libestr-dev \
            libfastjson-dev \
            libuuid-dev \
            libblkid-dev \
            libudev-dev \
            libaudit-dev \
            libjq-dev \
            librdkafka-dev \
            libpopt-dev \
            libwrap0-dev \
            libmysqlclient-dev \
            libpq-dev \
            libsqlite3-dev

      - name: Configure and Build with Scan-Build
        run: |
          export PATH="${{ runner.temp }}/llvm/bin:$PATH"
          mkdir -p build
          cd build
          cmake .. \
            -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang \
            -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++ \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug \
            -DENABLE_LIBDBI=OFF \
            -DENABLE_MYSQL=OFF \
            -DENABLE_PGSQL=OFF \
            -DENABLE_SQLITE=OFF \
            -DENABLE_REDIS=OFF \
            -DENABLE_KAFKA=OFF \
            -DENABLE_MMEXTERNAL=OFF \
            -DENABLE_IMMARKDOWN=OFF \
            -DENABLE_IMFILE=ON \
            -DENABLE_OMQ=OFF \
            -DENABLE_LIBSASL=OFF \
            -DENABLE_GSSAPI=OFF \
            -DENABLE_LIBFFI=OFF \
            -DENABLE_PYTHON=OFF \
            -DENABLE_LUA=OFF \
            -DENABLE_JAVA=OFF \
            -DENABLE_PERL=OFF \
            -DENABLE_RUBY=OFF \
            -DENABLE_GEMINI=OFF \
            -DENABLE_HTTP=OFF \
            -DENABLE_IMCURL=OFF \
            -DENABLE_OMCURL=OFF \
            -DENABLE_IMPTCP=OFF \
            -DENABLE_OMPUDP=OFF \
            -DENABLE_IMMARKDOWN=OFF \
            -DENABLE_IMMARKDOWN=OFF \
            -DENABLE_IMMARKDOWN=OFF
          scan-build-16 cmake --build . --target rsyslogd

      - name: Upload Scan-Build Reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: clang-analyzer-reports
          path: build/scan-build-report
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Log Artifact URL
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "## Clang Static Analyzer Results" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "The scan-build reports have been uploaded as an artifact." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "You can download them from the [Artifacts](https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}) section of this workflow run." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
```
